title: What do prospective accountancy clients need to understand first
body:
Try the fictional practice matrix and its generated brief. Which fields help a firm explain its service clearly, and which questions are missing? Share anonymised content-planning examples rather than client financial information. [Accountant Web Design](https://accountantwebdesign.uk/) maintains this resource. Please keep technical bugs in Issues and use this thread for structure and wording suggestions.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Accountant-Web-Design/practice-service-matrix#readme), then run the documented example locally.
